correctness.rationale: Rank m-1 and right orthogonal invariance make the null line Haar-uniform; Gaussian signs show containment probability 2^(1-m) independent of scales. Conditioning on common sign leaves independent half-normal magnitudes, and the t_i=s lambda_i Jacobian s^(m-1) gives the stated normalized density. With sigma_0=tau_m, lambda_0=X_0/(X_0+tau_m sum_{i>=1}X_i); the strong law proves three a_m=m tau_m regimes, the one-variable density and erfc survival follow by transformation, and a joint CLT/delta method gives the mixture fluctuation. The ordinary-weight empirical law and sum-of-squares ratio follow by strong laws. The conditional measures require every scale positive; exact zero is excluded.
